faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (adswizz vergibt je Abruf eine listeningSessionID, AIS leitet ueber hash_redirect um, Last-Modified liegt nur 1 s vor dem Abruf, Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst simplecastaudio.com) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: J Balvin performs a vibrant set for the Tiny Desk Home Concert series.
kurzfassung: J Balvin delivers an energetic performance for his Tiny Desk Home Concert in New York. He showcases tracks from his album Jose and expresses gratitude to his crew and fans. The set features a blend of signature reggaeton rhythms and live instrumentation.
stichpunkte: Introduction by host Ana Maria Sayer for the Tiny Desk Home Concert series
Performance of hit tracks with distinctive reggaeton beats
J Balvin greets the audience from a location in New York
Celebration and promotion of the new album Jose
Performance continues with dynamic crowd-pleasing anthems
Shout-outs to collaborators and crew members including DJ Pope and Marcus
Final expressions of gratitude and peace to close the set

clips.hook: Celebrating a new album in New York
clips.text: The performer greets the audience from a scenic spot in New York to celebrate the release of a new album.
The artist wraps up the performance by thanking the platform for the opportunity and acknowledging his band and crew.

beschreibung:
The reggaetón superstar kicks off our "El Tiny" takeover of the Tiny Desk (home) concert series.
